claims.claim: The DP Compact Portable Rechargeable LED Torch Light is suitable for homes, security personnel,...
claims.evidence: The witness report only shows a black cylindrical flashlight/torch with a clear front lens and no readable brand/model text; suitability/usage claims are not verifiable from the photos.

risks.risk: Whether it actually works (brightness/beam quality) and whether the LED is functional.
risks.proof: A short video clip turning it on in a dark room showing steady light output and the beam pattern (no flicker).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-tested/possibly faulty torch (worst-case: not working or very dim).

risks.risk: Rechargeable status: battery type, battery health, and whether it holds charge.
risks.proof: A clip showing it charging (charger indicator/light) and then running for a timed interval after full charge.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as battery condition unknown (worst-case: weak battery or needs replacement).

risks.risk: Switch and modes (high/low/strobe) may not function as claimed.
risks.proof: A clip cycling through all claimed modes with the switch (high/low/strobe) and showing each mode clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as single-mode/unknown controls (worst-case: only one mode works).

risks.risk: Physical condition not fully visible: lens scratches, cracks, dents, or water/dust sealing issues.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens (front), rubber ring, and body seams plus a quick wipe test showing no cracks/loose parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with potential cosmetic wear and unknown sealing (worst-case: damaged lens or compromised durability).

risks.risk: Power rating (lumens/wattage) and runtime are unknown; could be low-performance.
risks.proof: A photo of the label/spec sticker (lumens/wattage/runtime) or packaging/manual showing exact specs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as low-spec/unknown output (worst-case: basic LED torch performance).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (charger, batteries, holster/lanyard) could reduce value.
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing everything included: charger, cable, batteries (if separate), holster/lanyard/spare parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as torch only (worst-case: no charger/batteries included).

proof_requests: Turn it on in a dark area and record a short video showing brightness and beam pattern.
Show charging in progress and then a timed runtime test after full charge.
Cycle through every mode (high/low/strobe) and record each mode working.
Provide close-up photos of the front lens and the body seams/rubber ring for cracks/scratches.
Photo of any label/spec sticker (lumens/wattage/runtime) or packaging/manual.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a tactical-style rechargeable LED torch by type, so it can be priced at its worst-case used/untested value. However, performance, battery health, modes, and included accessories are not shown, so the price should assume the least favorable scenario until proof is provided.
